title: Infrastructure as Code — VPC Module, Multi-Environment Layout & CI Pipeline
title_es: Infrastructure as Code — Módulo de VPC, layout multi-entorno y pipeline CI
description: A runnable VPC module (private + public subnets across 3 AZs), a directory-per-environment layout (dev/staging/production with S3 backends and native locking), a GitHub Actions plan/apply pipeline, and a scheduled drift-check script — matching the guide's canonical structure.
description_es: Un módulo de VPC ejecutable (subnets privadas + públicas en 3 AZs), un layout de directorio-por-entorno (dev/staging/production con backends S3 y locking nativo), un pipeline plan/apply de GitHub Actions y un script programado de detección de drift — siguiendo la estructura canónica de la guía.
